Name: 4.1 square layout decoder (first order + subwoofer)
Description: Basic first-order Ambisonics decoder for four loudspeakers in a square around the listener (channels 1-4) plus a discrete bass-managed subwoofer on channel 5 (80 Hz LR4 crossover). SN3D normalization, ACN ordering (AmbiX), Condon-Shortley phase omitted.

Decoder.Name: Basic first-order 4.1 square decoder
Decoder.Description: First-order Ambisonics decoded to front-left (ch 1), front-right (ch 2), rear-right (ch 3), rear-left (ch 4), and discrete subwoofer (ch 5).

LoudspeakerLayout.Name: 4 speakers in a square (+ subwoofer on ch 5)
